Before tumor removal: my energy level was zero. My entire life. I think the tumor has always been quietly growing as I did.
After tumor removal: my energy at 8 am today was 100%. My energy level at noon was 100%. My energy level at 8pm was 100%.

#MedicareForAll is revolutionary.

1444477315275239429.a: I joined the Medicare For All Pilot Program 3 years ago. In Indiana, HIP+ (Medicare for All Pilot) is free for those making less than $17k/yr. $0. No copays, premiums, scams, etc. Whole body coverage for free or a few dollars/mo. No doctor has taken my health seriously until now.

1444478586312962048.a: I _chose_ to be treated at a state gov owned teaching hospital; profit-driven hospitals almost killed me. Young medical students, residents, & best teachers in the world. Level 1 Trauma center; covid has taught them much. Cutting edge tech they know how to use. We all need this.

1444479755445735426.a:
Downsides to choosing a Level 1 Trauma Center:
1. MRIs can take a day or two if you are stable.
2. Your procedure could be delayed if you are stable.
3. You might be moved out to a regular room earlier than ideal from ICU / IICU if you appear to be stable and healing.
#NoBigDeal
